title: knowledge capture: entry-write path + capture step at ticket close + Gate 5 emits drafts under auto_consolidate (R16)
description: Deep-review sweep #2 (2026-07-06) MEDIUM finding R16 (F29, adversarially confirmed) — also fix #1 of the Obsidian-KB evaluation (human ruled 2026-07-06: stay on current format; the capture-rate failure is process, not format — replace per-entry approval with batched curation). All 3 knowledge entries predate 2026-06-16 with last_seen_at == created_at, against 92+ closed tickets. The ticket-close protocol (SKILL.md:661-676) records only decision→task graph edges — no entry step; the only knowledge hook is Gate 5's consolidation pause, and the unattended preset sets auto_consolidate=true (loop.md:252-257) which skips it with NO substitute action (src/drive-loop.js:198); src/knowledge.js has no entry-write function at all — SKILL.md:728 mandates KB-first lookup, a read contract with no write path. Recurring expensive lessons (the 4x lock pid-identity class, TASK-078's five HIGH classes) never entered the KB. Depends on TASK-104 so new capture writes mint canonical graph ids from day one. Full context: synthesis §R16 + artifacts/obsidian-kb-research-2026-07-06.md.
acceptance_criteria: src/knowledge.js gains a schema-validated, atomic entry-write helper (the KB write path), mirroring the store's validate-before-write pattern — red-first specs including rejection of schema-invalid entries.

The ticket-close protocol (both SKILL.md copies + CLAUDE.md workflow step) adds a capture step: any reviewer HIGH finding or RC loop on a ticket produces a draft knowledge entry at close, written by the orchestrator WITHOUT per-entry human approval.

Drafts land in a designated unvetted location/state (e.g. knowledge/proposed/ or a vetted:false frontmatter flag) and the lookup either down-weights or excludes them — the chosen design is recorded as an explicit decision in the entry format docs.

Gate 5 under auto_consolidate no longer skips knowledge work: the consolidation checkpoint still emits/collects entry drafts, and the human's role is documented as batched promote/discard at consolidation (curator, not scribe).
The KB-first read contract now points at a real write path: SKILL.md's knowledge sections document when entries get created, by whom, and how promotion works.
